name: skill
description: 统一 skill 工具（action 分派）。action=list 列出所有可用 skill（渐进式披露第一级：仅 name + description，token 消耗极小）；action=use 激活指定 skill 并返回完整指令模板（第二级；目录式 skill 附带附属资源清单；args 替换模板中的 {{placeholder}} 占位符）。
description_en: Unified skill tool (dispatched by action). action=list lists all available skills (progressive disclosure level 1: name + description only, minimal token cost); action=use activates a skill and returns its full instruction template (level 2; directory-based skills include companion resources; args fill {{placeholder}} tokens).

skill.description_en: use: name of the skill to activate

args.description: use：替换到技能提示词占位符中的参数（如 {topic: "react hooks"} 对应 {{topic}}）。
args.description_en: use: arguments substituted into the skill prompt placeholders (e.g. {topic: "react hooks"} fills {{topic}}).
